services.name: Our Exhibits
services.desc: The Aurora Regional Fire Museum is proud to house and showcase a variety of artifacts and apparatus relating to the history of Aurora and firefighting in our region. During your visit to the museum, you can explore several permanent exhibits as well as various temporary and traveling exhibits. Permanent Gallery - Children’s Discovery Room -The Charles and Georgia Goodwin Aurora Room- This exhibit traces the role of tools and technology used by firefighters throughout American history. Visitors can pass leather fire buckets and imagine themselves in a bucket brigade, snap close an authentic quick-hitch fire horse collar, and ring the alarm rattle from the 1700s.
